newsitem.title: ZIMBABWE: ZIMBABWE DOLLAR STARTS WEEK SOFTER ON UNITS.
newsitem.headline: ZIMBABWE DOLLAR STARTS WEEK SOFTER ON UNITS.

text.p: The Zimbabwe dollar was quoted easier against hard units in early Monday trade compared to Friday's closing levels but dealers expected it to hold steady in quiet trade during the day.
"Everything is very quiet at the moment...I don't see anything much happening in the market today," one dealer said.

At around 0745 GMT, the Zimbabwe dollar was trading on the interbank market at 10.2300/2700 against the U.S. dollar, down from Friday's 10.1900/2600 and was marginally softer against sterling at 15.9540/16.0260 compared to 15.9500/0670.
It slipped to 6.8570/8850 from 6.8550/9040 on the German mark and was quoted at 2.2740/2830 versus South Africa's rand from 2.2610/2790.
